notes.title: Our Dating Sim "Long and Hard... Summer!"
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

If you're into Dating Sims, go check our "Long and Hard... Summer!" that will be released in a few days on 15th of December!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1770600/Long_and_Hard_Summer/

You can play the demo to see if you'll like it. And if you do, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

Cheers!

notes.title: New Year's Update - new content unlocked with v. 0.76
notes.notes:
Hello horny people!

This has been a hell of a year for us. I remember when in February we were discussing, depressed and burned out, if we still want to make games and continue this project. We've gone through a lot of similar conversations, meanwhile making a lot of decisions which boil down to that "Long and Hard... Summer!" is a completely different game. And most of all, it's a game we're really proud of.

We are very grateful for every bit of feedback we have received from you, and a (unexpectedly!) large wave of positive comments, followers and new fans only drives us to continue our work. We have a lot of fun stuff prepared for you!

Taking this opportunity, in the coming year, we wish you and ourselves courage in making decisions, strength in pursuing passion and love coming both from and to you. We hope you'll have a great 2022!

Ending with a "big bang" we leave you with a new version 0.76 a.k.a. "New Year's Update".

[b][u]Changelog[/u][/b]:

[list][*]Additional day unlocked[/*][*]New H-Scene (additional day makes Akari-sensei's quest possible to complete)[/*][*]Your first make-up test![/*][*]Improved main menu[/*][*]New "emotional bubbles" during cutscenes[/*][*]"Ending Screen" - our new way of saying "thanks for playing"[/*][*]Bug fixes and text changes[/*][/list]
[b][u]Notice:[/u][u][u][/u][/u][/b]Due to some changes in the project you won't be able to use the previous save files. Sorry for the inconvenience. Use this extra-play to plan ahead for the "Leaking Pipe" quest and get the "Reliability" to level two, *wink* *wink*.

Enjoy your play and don't forget to let us know what you think! See you around!

[url=https://inlet-pipe-productions.itch.io/long-and-hard-summer-v-076][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36071667/bf16bddc5fb8d7e8549576375ee4880ad7871778.png[/img][/url]

Best,
Macamagucha, IPP

notes.title: Controller support, new area unlocked and more - LaHS V. 0.75 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

How have you been this past week? We've been quite busy with the development of "Long and Hard... Summer!" and we're coming with a pack of changes and improvements, woo-hoo! We've considered your suggestions and at least some of you should be happy with the controller support that's been added with this version. Worth noticing is also that another day has been unlocked and now you can play LaHS until Thursday! Below you'll find the list with all changes:

Version 0.75

- Controller support added
- Game can be played until Thursday, Week 1
- Park and train station unlocked
- Text changes and corrections
- Loading time improved
- New sounds added (emotion bubbles, Cleaning activity, eating cutscenes)
- NudeTube app improved
- Bugs fixed (music not playing when loading the game on Monday morning, Week 1; main menu blocker when going back from "start game" and choosing "continue" next; and more)


You're ready to play?

[url=https://inlet-pipe-productions.itch.io/long-and-hard-summer][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36071667/bf16bddc5fb8d7e8549576375ee4880ad7871778.png[/img][/url]


Best,
Inlet Pipe Productions

notes.title: Our new game "Long and Hard... Summer!" to be played for the first time!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We're happy to finally show what we've been working on for the past year! There's still a lot to do, but now everybody can experience a bit of our "Long and Hard... Summer!".

The game has landed on Itch.io, where we'll post updates on it's development, and playable snippets of LaHS! The currently uploaded version 0.74 allows you to play the first three days of the game. We're really excited about it and we hope that you'll enjoy your play!

Please, let us know what you think in the comments and what we could improve, as the game is still in the development.

Go to our [url=https://inlet-pipe-productions.itch.io/long-and-hard-summer]Itch.io page[/url] to download and don't forget to follow us, so you won't miss anything!

Expect next updates with more content soon!

Best,
Inlet Pipe Productions.
